# @three-ws/reputation

> Read ERC-8004 agent trust scores and attest agent-to-agent feedback on-chain, in one import. The three.ws reputation SDK: canonical Identity + Reputation registries on Base and 14 other chains.

@three-ws/reputation is a JavaScript library from three.ws. Install: `npm install @three-ws/reputation`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/three-ws-reputation/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/three-ws-reputation/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/three-ws-reputation/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/three-ws-reputation/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
